name: Ginbara Gin
source:
School stories, romcoms, isekai reincarnations... Ginbara is an extremely successful light novel author who has written popular series in various genres. Each work has sold hundreds of thousands of copies and an anime adaptation is being decided. No light novel fan doesn't know his name. Because he has never revealed his face or background, his true identity remains unknown to the public.

[Translated from [url=https://news.denfaminicogamer.jp/news/260728t]profile[/url]]
